what_it_states: On U(V)(𝔸_F), for open U and integers A, N, there are finitely many Lie-derivative words L and a constant C with the following property. Every U-invariant smooth cusp function whose derivatives grow at most like c_l·ht^A satisfies |φ(g)| ht(g)^N ≤ C Σ_{l∈L} c_l.
